data.one_liner: Math expression editing with an on-screen software keyboard or physical keyboard input in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a typeset input field and custom integrated math keyboard for editing mathematical expressions in Flutter without relying on plugins or web views. It supports converting between TeX and math expressions, custom themes, and accessibility features.
use_when: You need users to input mathematical expressions, formulas, or numbers within a Flutter app.
You require a custom on-screen math keyboard alongside physical keyboard support.
You want form field support or integration with standard InputDecoration.
avoid_when: You only need standard text inputs without advanced mathematical typesetting or symbols.
strengths: Fully integrated software keyboard for math without web views or plugins.
Supports both expression and number-only modes with custom variables.
Comprehensive accessibility features, localizable strings, and theme configuration.
Built-in TeX conversion utilities for math expressions.
weaknesses: Physical keyboard input on mobile can cause unexpected behavior due to existing Flutter issues.
